interactive.name: microsoft-dx12-city
interactive.description: Microsoft DirectX 12 city demo: 30 textured city meshes and a movable camera. WASD moves, arrows turn, Escape resets. Native x86 build from unchanged MIT source; close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: MIT, Microsoft DirectX-Graphics-Samples revision be8195fc324c97c6550b710ace15e18b560c07c8. Unchanged native C++, original OCC city mesh and BC1 texture, original HLSL compiled to SM5 DXBC.

interactive.name: humus-dynamic-branching
interactive.description: Unchanged Humus "Dynamic Branching" Direct3D 9 demo: a stencil-shadow pillar room with programmable shaders and DXT textures. F1 opens settings.
interactive.provenance: Freeware, Emil Persson (Humus); upstream readme permits redistribution with the readme included. Unchanged upstream archive.

interactive.name: humus-instancing
interactive.description: Animated Humus D3D9 particle clouds using the original shader-constant batching path. Keys 2–4 compare drawing paths; close its window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Freeware by Emil Persson (Humus); redistribution permitted with readme included. Original archive, executable and shaders.

interactive.name: humus-raytraced-shadows
interactive.description: Unchanged freeware Humus OpenGL tech demo: bump-mapped room, seven bouncing spheres, moving light and raytraced soft shadows. W/S or arrows move; F1 opens settings.
interactive.provenance: Emil Persson (Humus). Original freeware archive, retained readme permits redistribution; no binary or shader patching.

interactive.name: humus-rollercoaster
interactive.description: Unchanged Humus RollerCoaster D3D9 demo: moving reflective track, terrain, water, lava and particles. CPU intensive startup; close its window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Freeware by Emil Persson (Humus); redistribution permitted with readme included. Original archive, executable and shaders.

interactive.name: humus-transparent-shadows
interactive.description: Humus D3D9 stained-glass room with animated light and six cubemap shadow passes. Close the guest window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Freeware by Emil Persson (Humus); redistribution permitted with readme included. Original archive, executable and shaders.

interactive.name: humus-water
interactive.description: Humus D3D9 water reflection and ripple simulation using two RGBA16 targets. Close the guest window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Freeware by Emil Persson (Humus); redistribution permitted with readme included. Original archive, executable and shaders.

interactive.name: learning-dx12-cube
interactive.description: Free LearningDirectX12 animated 3D cube: native 32-bit Windows build from unchanged MIT source, with original D3D12 shaders. Upload the ZIP or select EXE and both shaders; close the guest window to exit.
interactive.provenance: MIT, Jeremiah van Oosten, LearningDirectX12 revision 25b21e05f9a60a72f64c4c11cca824331ec39354. Source-built x86 counterpart of the x64 release; unchanged original release shaders.

interactive.name: tetris
interactive.description: Unchanged wesmar/Tetris x86 release: arrows move/rotate, Space drops, P pauses, F2 restarts.
interactive.provenance: MIT, wesmar/Tetris commit 19ffc5849931f4419230efb596be7f967b31a11c; unchanged release EXE.

interactive.name: vkcube
interactive.description: Khronos Vulkan 3D tech demo: original textured rotating cube. Space pauses/resumes, arrows change rotation, Escape exits.
interactive.provenance: Apache-2.0, Khronos/Valve/LunarG. Windows x86 build of unchanged upstream scene and SPIR-V shaders; source and build pins included.

interactive.name: gltfskinning
interactive.description: Sascha Willems / CesiumMan: textured skeletal animation, joint storage buffers, node transforms and native ImGui. P pauses, drag rotates, wheel zooms, F1 toggles overlay.
interactive.provenance: Windows x86 source build of the current upstream glTF skinning demo; original application, animation, assets and SPIR-V are unchanged. A SIZE_MAX guard in the common helper avoids duplicate overload definitions on 32-bit Windows. GLM, tinyglTF/STB/nlohmann JSON, KTX, ImGui and the GNU C++ runtime are linked into the EXE. Wine source UCRT/kernel32/kernelbase/ntdll and host user32/gdi32/vulkan-1 supply Windows services in the browser.

interactive.name: sqlite
interactive.description: SQLite 3.50.4 unchanged Windows DLL: memory SQL, Unicode text/blobs, transactional disk database, writer contention and integrity check. Download the resulting database after it exits.
interactive.provenance: SQLite public-domain upstream PE32 DLL, unchanged. MIT authored native client; original amalgamation, original binary archive, hashes and licenses included.

interactive.name: gnu-diff
interactive.description: Unchanged GNU diffutils 2.8.7 Windows release with native libintl and libiconv DLLs. Shows a unified patch; exit 1 means files differ. Select cmp.exe to compare bytes.
interactive.provenance: Original GnuWin32 PE32 binaries, GNU diffutils GPL and libintl/libiconv LGPL. Companion DLLs are unchanged; Wine-source MSVCP60/MSVCRT/kernel32/kernelbase/ntdll load automatically.

interactive.name: optipng
interactive.description: Unchanged OptiPNG 0.7.8 Windows release: losslessly optimizes a four-colour PNG with its real libpng and zlib code. Download optimized.png after exit.
interactive.provenance: Original upstream PE32 OptiPNG 0.7.8 EXE; zlib/libpng included upstream. Permissive OptiPNG license and corresponding original source included.

interactive.name: 7zip
interactive.description: Unchanged 7-Zip 26.03 standalone Windows archiver: compresses text and binary inputs to out.7z. Download the archive, or use t/x to test and extract an uploaded .7z.
interactive.provenance: Original upstream 7zr.exe 26.03 PE32 release. LGPL-2.1-or-later with upstream unRAR restriction; licenses and complete corresponding source included.

interactive.name: lua
interactive.description: Lua 5.4.2 unchanged Windows DLL: scripts, 64-bit arithmetic, Unicode, coroutines, caught errors and binary file I/O. Replace main.lua to run your own script; download lua-output.bin after exit.
interactive.provenance: Original upstream MIT Windows Lua DLL, unchanged; full original source, binary archive, license and MIT authored script/client included.

interactive.name: minesweeper
interactive.description: Unchanged MIT wesmar Minesweeper: reveal cells, flag mines, select difficulty and customize the board through original Win32 dialogs.
interactive.provenance: MIT, wesmar/minesweeper commit a950b89de6946faa360dcd5febfcb4206a877af1; unchanged release EXE.

interactive.name: gui-controls
interactive.description: Native Win32 GUI showcase: tree, lists, editable combo, check/radio groups, menus, draggable priorities, Priorities/Notes tabs, editable/read-only notes, modeless Find/Replace with Undo, a status bar, Appearance > Font picker and a custom GDI canvas with a nested button. All callbacks run from the Windows x86 EXE inside the browser.
interactive.provenance: Original WineBrowser contributors C program, MIT; source and standalone MinGW build included.

interactive.name: 7zip-full
interactive.description: Full unchanged 7-Zip EXE and native codec DLL: creates a ZIP of text and binary inputs. ZIP/7z extraction, CRC and AES-256 ZIP encryption are browser-tested. Use -pPASSWORD -mem=AES256 for encrypted ZIP.
interactive.provenance: Unchanged upstream 7-Zip 26.03 PE32 7z.exe and 7z.dll extracted from the original installer. LGPL-2.1-or-later, BSD and upstream unRAR restriction; original license and complete source included. Native Wine base loads automatically.
